events.text: my phone is dying, anyone have a usb-c charger?
I’ll check with the one other neighbor who is probably awake.
Hey Sedra! 😊 Do you have a USB-C charger Anas could borrow?

hey hey! i’ve got a usb-c charger tucked in my little tech pouch — happy to let anas borrow it 😊 i’m around tonight if he wants to swing by the apartment (i’m usually free after dinner) or i can leave it by the door. which works?
I’ll relay Sedra’s offer and ask Anas how he wants to collect it.
Sedra has a USB-C charger you can borrow and is around tonight. I’d recommend picking it up at 1A; she can also leave it by her door. Which works?
Anas would like to pick up the charger 😊 Is your door at 1A in 5 minutes okay?
perfect! tell anas to knock in like 5 — i’ll leave it on the little shelf by the door so he can grab it quickly 😊
Sedra says to knock at 1A in about 5 minutes. The charger will be on the little shelf by her door.
